newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Technologie sees strong 1996 pretax.
newsitem.headline: VA Technologie sees strong 1996 pretax.

text.p: Austrian engineering group VA Technologie AG said on Thursday it expected a strong growth in its 1996 turnover and pretax profit.
The group said its order backlog in 1996 provisionally rose 22 percent to 81 billion schillings, while order intake climbed 27 percent to 45 billion.
Group turnover rose 26 percent to 33 billion schillings according to preliminary figures.
The group said in a statement it would continue its growth in business volume and profit in 1997.
The order intake of the group's metallurgical engineering area grew by 60 percent and accounted for 34 percent of VA Technologie's total order intake in 1996.
Energy and environmental engineering grew by six percent from 1995 and constituted 34 percent of order intake.
Order intake in plant engineering and services grew by 28 percent and contributed 32 percent of the group's order intake.
